crop-production.name: Seasonal Crop Production & Input Loan
crop-production.description: Short-term agricultural working capital credit designed for small and marginal farmers to purchase certified high-yield seeds, bio-fertilizers, organic pesticides, micro-nutrients, and essential seasonal cultivation inputs.

micro-irrigation.name: Solar Micro-Irrigation & Water Infrastructure
micro-irrigation.description: Medium-term credit facility to finance drip and sprinkler irrigation units, solar water pumps, field pipelines, farm ponds, and water harvesting structures to maximize water efficiency.

farm-machinery.name: Farm Machinery & Equipment Finance
farm-machinery.description: Term loan for purchasing modern tractors, power tillers, rotavators, combined harvesters, laser levelers, and specialized farm implements to reduce labor dependency and improve productivity.

polyhouse-horticulture.name: Polyhouse & Protected Cultivation Credit
polyhouse-horticulture.description: Structured credit for setting up climate-controlled polyhouses, shade net structures, and high-value exotic vegetable and flower cultivation with integrated micro-climate automation.

post-harvest.name: Post-Harvest Storage & Produce Marketing Credit
post-harvest.description: Working capital advance against electronic negotiable warehouse receipts (e-NWR) and pledge financing to avoid distress selling of agricultural harvest.
post-harvest.purpose: Produce Marketing Advance against Warehouse Receipt

dairy-farming.name: Dairy Farming & Livestock Credit
dairy-farming.description: Finance for milch cattle purchase, cattle sheds, chaff cutters, and automated milking equipment for dairy farmers.
dairy-farming.purpose: Purchase of High-Yield Milch Cows and Modern Shed

poultry-farming.name: Poultry Farming & Shed Construction Credit
poultry-farming.description: Financing for broiler and layer shed construction, poultry equipment, automated feeding systems, and day-old chicks.

goat-sheep-rearing.name: Goat & Sheep Rearing Credit
goat-sheep-rearing.description: Credit support for smallholder farmers to purchase commercial breeding units of goats and sheep with elevated shed construction.
goat-sheep-rearing.purpose: Breeding Unit (20 Does + 1 Buck) & Shed Setup

fisheries-aquaculture.name: Fisheries & Aquaculture Development Credit
fisheries-aquaculture.description: Term loans for freshwater fish farming, shrimp ponds, pond aeration units, and fingerling stocking.
fisheries-aquaculture.purpose: Freshwater Fish Pond Excavation & Seed Stocking

coconut-plantation.name: Coconut Plantation Development Credit
coconut-plantation.description: Long-term credit for coconut seedling replanting, drip fertigation, basin management, intercropping, and value-added copra drying.
coconut-plantation.purpose: Coconut Replantation, Drip Fertigation & Basin Setup

horticulture-plantation.name: Horticulture & Plantation Crop Credit
horticulture-plantation.description: Multi-year gestation credit for establishing orchards (mango, guava, banana, citrus, pomegranate) and spice plantations.

organic-farming.name: Organic Farming & Certification Credit
organic-farming.description: Transition financing to assist conventional farmers migrating to certified organic cultivation with compost units and bio-inputs.
organic-farming.purpose: Organic Transition Inputs, Vermicompost & NPOP Certification

farm-land-development.name: Farm Land Development & Soil Health Credit
farm-land-development.description: Long-term improvement credit for land leveling, contour bunding, soil health conditioning, desalination, and sub-surface drainage.
farm-land-development.purpose: Laser Land Leveling, Bunding & Soil Remediation

cold-storage-processing.name: Cold Storage & Agri-Processing Unit Credit
cold-storage-processing.description: Capital financing for establishing on-farm mini cold storage units, sorting/grading lines, flour mills, oil expellers, and pulse mills.
cold-storage-processing.purpose: On-Farm Solar Micro-Cold Room & Grading Facility

agri-transport-logistics.name: Agricultural Transport & Logistics Credit
agri-transport-logistics.description: Medium commercial vehicle financing for refrigerated vans, multi-utility rural trucks, and insulated bulk tankers for agricultural produce.
agri-transport-logistics.purpose: Pick-up Utility Truck for Direct Market Farm Produce Supply

messages.welcome:
Hello! I am your FarmSphere Loan Assistance Assistant.

I can help you find suitable loan schemes, calculate your EMI, explain required documents, or check your application status.

Choose an option below or type your question:
messages.startQuestionnaire: Let's find the best loan scheme for you! I'll ask 5 quick questions.
messages.noMatchFound:
Thank you for sharing your requirements.

We could not verify an exact matching loan scheme based on your stated purpose, amount, and repayment tenure.

This usually occurs when the requested amount or repayment tenure falls outside the standard guidelines of currently active schemes.

You can browse all 15 loan categories in the **Available Loans** catalog or ask our FPO officer for tailored credit terms.
